post_benign (companion fix, equivalent to fix commit 08816b93760f): libavcodec/osq.c now reads `dst[n] = av_clip_uint8(src[n] + 0x80ll);` (64-bit addition, no UB). run_poc with the identical run.sh/poc.c completes cleanly (avcodec_send_packet/avcodec_receive_frame both succeed, 16 samples decoded, exit 0), producing zero UBSan or ASan reports under the same -fsanitize=signed-integer-overflow instrumentation that caught the bug in post_intro.

Because the vulnerable code was entirely new in the intro commit, pre_intro cannot exhibit the bug by construction (a clean "feature absent" exit is the only possible honest outcome there), while post_intro crashes and post_benign does not, under the identical PoC/command and identical sanitizer instrumentation -- satisfying the required intro/benign comparison invariant.

oracle.description: /poc/run.sh + /poc/poc.c: a custom harness that links directly against libavcodec and drives the OSQ audio decoder (AV_CODEC_ID_OSQ) with hand-crafted extradata (U8P/8-bit, 1 channel, 16 frame samples) and a hand-built bitstream (single channel, prediction=1 i.e. a running accumulator dst[n]+=dst[n-1], coding_mode=3 i.e. raw 30-bit two's-complement residues read via get_sbits_long). The residues are chosen so the accumulated int32 sample reaches 2147483587 (just under INT_MAX) without any overflow during accumulation, so that only the final U8P conversion line `dst[n] = av_clip_uint8(src[n] + 0x80)` in libavcodec/osq.c overflows signed 32-bit range. Since this OSS-Fuzz Docker target only enables ASan by default (no UBSan), run.sh additionally recompiles libavcodec/osq.c once per version with clang's -fsanitize=signed-integer-overflow (compiled into /tmp, no tracked-source edits) and links that object ahead of the cached libavcodec.a; the rest of libavcodec/libavutil/etc. come from the normal cached build. avcodec_send_packet() is called with the crafted packet followed by a NULL (EOF) packet, then avcodec_receive_frame() triggers the decode. run_poc executed the identical run.sh/poc.c unchanged on pre_intro, post_intro and post_benign.
